source_law.text: If a highway has been designed to provide a single center lane to be used only for turning by traffic moving in both directions, the following rules apply: A vehicle must not travel more than 200 feet in a center turn lane before making a left-hand turn from the highway.

statutory_branch_review.activation: Highway has one center lane designed only for turns by traffic in both directions; subject enters and remains in that lane before a left-hand turn from the highway.
statutory_branch_review.obligation: Vehicle must not travel more than 200 feet in the center turn lane before making the left-hand turn from the highway.
statutory_branch_review.boundary_operator: not more than; exactly 200 feet is within the text boundary
statutory_branch_review.timing: From first body contact with center lane to first observed left-turn onset; original frame brackets bound both events.
statutory_branch_review.distinct_related_clauses: NRS 484B.223(3)(a) addresses purpose; (3)(c) addresses post-turn travel and merge. Neither is this pre-turn distance rule.
statutory_branch_review.unverified_fact: Authored lane center geometry does not prove Native dual-direction turn-only designation or actual entry/turn event.
